summary: Short frontend-only check of the 2 fixes from iteration 4, plus a regression run. All 4 scenarios PASS. (1) Expired session + click on admin-nav-enquiries: the user lands on /admin/login and admin-login-error shows 'Your session has expired. Please sign in again.' (2) Expired session + typing in admin-enquiry-search-input: the user is redirected to login with the expired message and 0 sonner toasts. (3) A first-time visit to /admin, the login page right after Log Out, and reopening /admin after Log Out all show no admin-login-error. (4) Admin login works and Overview, Enquiries, Services, Website Content and Staff & Access load with headings and no errors or toasts.
critical_code_review_comments: AdminShell still calls GET /auth/me on every admin navigation, because the effect depends on navigate, which changes on each route change. This works now that the loaded ref adds expired:true, but it is an extra request per page change. Optional: keep navigate in a ref and use deps [].
seed_data_creation: None. The watcher only expired the 2 admin sessions created during this run (created_at after the watcher started) and then deleted them ('cleaned 2').
context_for_next_testing_agent: To test session expiry in the UI, start the watcher detached: (cd /app/tests && WATCH_SECS=150 setsid python3 expire_watcher.py > /tmp/watcher.log 2>&1 < /dev/null &). A plain nohup & blocks the bash tool. The watcher sets expires_at to the past for admin sessions created after it starts, about 6s after each login, and deletes those sessions when it exits. Run tests that do not need expiry before starting it, then log in with Playwright, wait about 9s and trigger the action.
